source_window.resource_title: Official public guidance for digital registered-land title-number/location discovery
source_window.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 for the guidance page; target MapSearch use requires Business e-services portal access

field_evidence.mapsearch_scope: HM Land Registry states that Business e-services customers can use MapSearch to establish whether land/property is registered, view its location, obtain title numbers and tenure details.
field_evidence.access_application: The official guidance states that MapSearch access requires an application for HM Land Registry Business e-services and agreement to the Conditions of use.
field_evidence.portal_login: The guidance states that users need an HM Land Registry portal account and must log in to the portal to use MapSearch.
field_evidence.payment_account_prerequisite: Although MapSearch itself is described as free-to-use, Business e-services signup requires at least one Variable Direct Debit account for chargeable services.
field_evidence.result_limit: The public guidance page exposes service semantics only; it does not return a target-specific Forge Cottage MapSearch result, title number, or parcel/title polygon.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: MapSearch can display registered-land location and save a reference PDF snapshot, but this public/no-login window does not expose a machine-readable target parcel geometry suitable for canonical promotion.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Without a target-specific authoritative title result and machine-readable parcel/title polygon, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry MapSearch can establish whether land/property is registered, display its location and return title numbers, but target use requires Business e-services enrolment, a portal account and login. The public/no-login guidance window therefore cannot return the target-specific Forge Cottage title result or a machine-readable canonical parcel/title polygon. Local OpenCode or an authorised HM Land Registry workflow must bind the exact target title polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from the application-and-fee Search the index map workflow to HM Land Registry's digital MapSearch title-number/location discovery service. The official guidance is public/no-login, but MapSearch itself is restricted to Business e-services customers with a portal account and login. No target-specific MapSearch result is exposed in the public guidance window, and no machine-readable parcel geometry is returned here. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
